title: Characterization of Cardiovascular Risk Profile and Therapeutic Management in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Italy
official: Characterization of Cardiovascular Risk Profile and Therapeutic Management in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Italy - CardioMET Registry
summary: CardioMET is an observational, multicenter, real-life registry, intending to collect data on patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, attending internal medicine and cardiology outpatient clinics. The aim of the registry is to characterize the cardiovascular risk profile and pharmacological management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Italy, in accordance with current ESC and AHA guidelines for primary and secondary prevention of CV disease.

sites.f: Federico II University of Naples, Department of Advanced Biomedical Sciences
